test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusion carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statement:

Some guavas are mangos.

All mangos are pears.

Some pears are grapes.

Conclusions:

I.Some guavas are grapes.

II.Some guavas are pears.

III. Some mangos the grapes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c3374ce2c3926816cf73186f785b47561bd623f1a8f6e31fa692aacd6457054.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some guavas are grapes → Does not follow (As some guavas are mangos, all mangos are pears and some pears are grapes. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some guavas are pears → Follow (As some guavas are mangos and all mangos are pears. As whole mangoes comes in pears and has some part common with guavas, therefore it is true.)

III. Some mangos the grapes → Does not follow (As all mangos are pears and some pears are grapes. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
